project.description:
This job loads the secondary terms from the UniProt data into the database. This includes the following: - Interpro - GO - EC - ProSite - Pfam The primary load for the UniProt data must be run first.
Picks the newest uniprot_release row that has a processed_date but no secondary_load_date. Aborts if more than 30,000 actions are generated (override: ACTION_SIZE_ERROR_THRESHOLD).
INPUTS (external, downloaded each run unless supplied locally): https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/uniprotkb_kw2go (UP2GO_FILE) https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/interpro2go (IP2GO_FILE) https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/ec2go (EC2GO_FILE) https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/interpro/current_release/entry.list (DOMAIN_FILE) - InterPro domain names and types
INPUT (on disk): the already-downloaded UniProt release file under /research/zarchive/load_files/UniProt-archive/ (UNIPROT_RELEASE_ARCHIVE_DIR). No fresh UniProt download happens here.
OUTPUT (tables written) - only when UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES is checked: db_link add/remove INTERPRO, EC, PFAM, PROSITE accessions record_attribution attributions for the added dblinks marker_go_term_evidence add/remove GO annotations derived from the InterPro, EC, and UniProt keyword mappings inference_group_member inferred-from entries for those annotations interpro_protein insert/delete InterPro domain records (ID, name, type) protein insert new proteins; update up_length protein_to_interpro insert/delete protein <-> InterPro domain pairs protein_to_pdb insert/delete protein <-> PDB structure pairs marker_to_protein insert/delete gene <-> protein pairs reference_protein delete rows tied to removed dblinks uniprot_release sets secondary_load_date
REFERENCE TABLES (snapshotted into the "context" before actions are computed, so only diffs get applied; replayable via CONTEXT_INPUT_FILE): db_link existing InterPro/EC/Pfam/PROSITE/UniProtKB accessions marker_go_term_evidence existing annotations from these mappings interpro_protein, protein, protein_to_interpro, protein_to_pdb, marker_to_protein term GO terms named by the *2go files publication the InterPro2GO / EC2GO / UniProtKB-KW2GO mapping pubs uniprot_release which release to load; completion marker
Full I/O documentation: reference/data-load-jobs.md#uniprot-secondary-term-load

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UNIPROT_COMMIT_CHANGES
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Check this option to commit the results of the load. Otherwise, it's a dry run.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: TIMESTAMP=`date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S` echo "WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE" echo "PWD=$PWD" echo "UNIPROT_LOAD_MODE=$UNIPROT_LOAD_MODE" rm -f $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report.json $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report.json.report.html $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report*.json.zip $PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report*.html.zip export UNIPROT_OUTPUT_FILE="$PWD/uniprot_secondary_load_report_$TIMESTAMP.json.zip" cd $SOURCEROOT gradle uniprotSecondaryTermLoadTask
